summary.name: SomniAI
summary.one_liner: SomniAI is a web service that uses AI to interpret dream content, drawing on dream symbols, archetypes, and an AI-assisted dream journal.
use_cases: Interpreting the meaning of a recurring or vivid dream
Keeping a dream journal with AI-enriched insights
Preparing notes to discuss dreams with a therapist
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI service that analyzes dreams and returns symbolic interpretations, including meanings of common symbols such as water, fire, and darkness. It offers a dream journal that the page says reveals patterns in inner life, and a catalogue of over 5,000 dream symbols with cross-cultural meanings. It also lists techniques and exercises for lucid dreaming and dream recall, plus an AI coach. Paid tiers add unlimited analyses, advanced correlations, sleep tracking, a breathing coach, sound therapies and monthly reports.
notable: Symbol-based dream analysis referencing Jung and Freud, with a catalogue of over 5,000 dream symbols
Free tier of 3 analyses per month; paid plans listed in euros, billed annually
Dreams stored on European servers with end-to-end encryption, per the page
Page states it is a self-care tool and not a replacement for medical follow-up
caveats: Paid plans (4.90€ and 9.90€ per month, billed annually) unlock unlimited analyses and advanced features
Page states it does not replace medical follow-up or therapy
Claimed results such as 87% anxiety reduction and 4.9/5 rating are marketing claims on the page, not independently verified
